in_sanskrit.name: भवन्श
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भव (Bhava) - existence, वन् (Van) - forest, श (Sha) - Lord. The name Bhavansh signifies the Lord's existence in the forest.

in_hindi.name: भवन्श
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bhavan (भवन) - house, श (Sha) - Lord. The name Bhavansh signifies the Lord residing in a pure house or abode.

in_tamil.name: பவன்ஷ
in_tamil.meaning: பவன் (Bhavan) - God, ஷ (Sha) - Lord. The name Bhavansh signifies the Lord in the form of God.

in_telugu.name: భవన్ష
in_telugu.meaning: భవన్ (Bhavanu) - Lord, శ (Sha) - Lord. The name Bhavansh signifies the Lord's existence or presence.

in_marathi.name: Bhavansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Creation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhavansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhavansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bhava' (existence) and 'Ansh' (essence). It is believed to represent the creator of the universe and is a revered name in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Bhavansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Creation
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhavansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhavansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bhava' (existence) and 'Ansh' (essence). It is believed to represent the creator of the universe and is a revered name in Hindu mythology.
